evidence: The films were deposited onto 5 cm × 5 cm substrates in a flow-type F-120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Oy, Helsinki, Finland). The reactor was operated under a pressure of about 10 mbar using nitrogen (made on site by a Nitrox UHPN 3000 generator, rated purity of 99.9995 %) as a carrier and purging gas.
